div.head: II Cn 20
div.ab: ⁊ we wyllað, þæt ælc freoman beo on hundrede ⁊ on teoðunge gebroht, þe lade wyrðe beon wylle oððon weres wyrðe, gyf hine hwa teon wylle, ofer þæt he byð XIIwintre; oþþon he ne beo syððan æniges freorihtes wyrðe.
And we wyllaþ, þæt ælc freoman beo on hundrede ⁊ on teoþunge gebroht, þe lade wyrðe beon wille oððe weres wyrðe, gyf hine hwa fylle ofer twelfwintra; oððe he ne beo æniges freorihtes wyrðe.

Et uolumus, ut omnis homo liber in hundreto et in decima positus sit, qui purgatione dignus esse uelit aut wera, si quis eum post XII. etatis suę annum affligat (accuset); uel non sit aliqua liberorum rectitudine dignus.

Þæt ælc mon beo on teoðunge. We wyllað þæt ælc freoman beo on hundrede ⁊ on teoðunge gebroht, ðe lade wyrðe beon wylle oððe weres wyrðe, gyf hine hwa afylle, ofer twelfwintre; oþþe he ne beo æniges freorihtes wyrðe,

Every man shall be in a tithing. It is our desire that every freeman, over twelve years of age, who desires to have the right of exculpation and of being atoned for by the payment of his wergeld, if he is slain, shall be brought within a hundred and a tithing; otherwise he shall not be entitled to any of the rights of a freeman,

(Dass jedermann in Zehntschaft sei. B) Und wir wünschen, dass jeder Freie über zwölfjährig (nachdem er zw. ist G), welcher, wenn ihn jemand verklagen will (niederstreckt BA), des Reinigungsbeweisrechtes theilhaftig — bezw. [wenn erschlagen, der Bezahlung durch] Wergeld theilhaftig — sein will, in Hundertschaft und in Zehntschaft gebracht werde; sonst sei er (späterhin G) keines Freienrechtes theilhaftig.

(That everyone be in a tithing. B) And we will that every free man over twelve years old (once he is twelve, G) who wishes to be entitled to clear himself [if accused] — or [if slain] to have his wergild paid — if anyone wishes to accuse him (strikes him down, B A), be brought into a hundred and into a tithing; otherwise let him (thereafter, G) not be entitled to any free man's rights.
div.note: G's ‘teon’ (accuse; compare Quadr.) against B's ‘afylle’, A's ‘fylle’ (strike down; compare Inst., Consiliatio); perhaps both stood in the archetype, one added later (Liebermann). G's ‘syððan’ and ‘þæt he byð’ are missing from the others. B's heading is red.
